ev.q: In 2016, 2.0% of adults aged ≥25 years who were surveyed had been told by a doctor or other health professional
Source: Tables of summary health statistics for U.S. adults, National Health Interview Survey, 2016.
Estimates are based on household interviews of a sample of the civilian, noninstitutionalized U.S. population

methods_quotes.q: Estimates are age-adjusted to the projected 2000 U.S. population as the standard population using four age groups
With 95% confidence intervals shown with error bars.
